instructions: Always run `flutter test` and `flutter analyze` before considering a task complete
Commit changes frequently with clear messages referencing the task/phase
Prefer composition over inheritance for widgets
Keep widgets small - extract when exceeding ~100 lines
Don't add packages without explicit approval
When creating screens, include loading and error states
Test database operations manually before moving on
Keep the egg logging flow as simple as possible - this is the core UX

models: Use freezed for immutable data classes with copyWith
All models have toMap() and fromMap() for SQLite
Use uuid package for IDs (not auto-increment)
Dates stored as ISO8601 strings in SQLite
database: Never expose raw database outside repositories
providers: Use AsyncNotifier for data that loads from DB
Keep providers focused - split if they get complex
ui: Screens are full pages, receive IDs as params
Widgets are reusable components, receive data as params
Use ref.watch in build methods, ref.read in callbacks
error_handling: Repositories return data or throw exceptions
Providers catch exceptions and expose via AsyncValue

quick_egg_log.description: Bottom sheet triggered from FAB anywhere in app
flow: Show number picker (default: yesterday's count for this flock)

provider_exposes: isReadOnly: bool (trial expired AND not purchased)

behavior: Egg logging respects this as default
